title: Countably rectifiable sets are covered by bi-Lipschitz C^1 chart images (Simon Ch. 3, Lemma 1.2 'only if', Remark 1.3)
statement: Let n >= 1, l >= 0 and let M be a countably n-rectifiable subset of R^(n+l) (SimonGMT Chapter03.CountablyRectifiable n M: M is contained in M_0 union U_j F_j(R^n) with H^n(M_0) = 0 and F_j : R^n -> R^(n+l) Lipschitz). Then there are a set N_0 with H^n(N_0) = 0 and, for k in N, C^1 maps G_k : R^n -> R^(n+l), centres c_k in R^n and radii rho_k in R such that, writing B'_k for the open ball B'_{rho_k}(c_k): (i) DG_k(v) is injective for every v in B'_k; (ii) there is kappa_k > 0 with kappa_k |v - w| <= |G_k(v) - G_k(w)| for all v, w in B'_k; and (iii) M is contained in N_0 union U_k G_k(B'_k).
lean_statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} (M : Set (Amb n ℓ)), 1 ≤ n → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.CountablyRectifiable n M → ∃ (N₀ : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (G : ℕ → Rn n → Amb n ℓ) (c : ℕ → Rn n) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) N₀ = 0 ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (G k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ v ∈ ball (c k) (ρ k), Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (G k) v)) ∧ (∀ k, ∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∀ v ∈ ball (c k) (ρ k), ∀ w ∈ ball (c k) (ρ k), κ * ‖v - w‖ ≤ ‖G k v - G k w‖) ∧ M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ k, G k '' ball (c k) (ρ k)
